description: From the public road in southern Bonaire, white salt pyramids stand beside shallow pans. Some water is pale copper-pink and some is blue-green, not one neon lake. The industrial yard itself is not entered. It is still day: clear, about 28.9°C, with a breeze near 23.8 km/h and no rain. Sunset is 18:26 America/Kralendijk, so 18:19 is low sun, about seven minutes before sunset. This is not the Kralendijk waterfront.
